title: CurFinity
description: This is the first modpack that will be played on the upcoming Larlogo's Community Modded Server.
body:
# Welcome to Larlogo’s First Official Modpack

Step into the very first modpack created by Larlogo — designed for the community’s upcoming modded survival server and built to deliver an exciting mix of adventure, exploration, progression, and performance.

This pack transforms Minecraft into a massive multiplayer experience filled with upgraded structures, dangerous dimensions, powerful bosses, improved storage systems, and carefully selected quality-of-life features. Whether you’re exploring solo or playing with friends, there’s always something new waiting to be discovered.

## Features Included

**Enhanced World Generation** Explore beautifully redesigned vanilla structures with the incredible mods such as YUNG's Better Mods, Biomes O' Plenty, Better Mods, Quark, and many many more.

**Unique Loot for Every Player** With Lootr, every player gets their own rewards from generated chests — no more missing out because someone looted first.

**New Dimensions to Explore** Venture into the skies of the Aether or journey through the mysterious Twilight Forest filled with secrets, dungeons, and memorable boss fights.

**Epic Boss Battles** Challenge iconic enemies like the Naga, Lich, and many more powerful creatures across multiple dimensions.

**Modern Storage Solutions** Applied Energistics 2 & Storage Drawers gives you access to a clean and efficient digital storage system, helping you organize your growing collection of items with ease.

**Performance & Optimization** A collection of optimization mods helps improve FPS, reduce lag, and provide a smoother gameplay experience both in singleplayer and on servers.

**Carefully Curated Mod Selection** From adventure and exploration to quality-of-life improvements, this pack includes a wide variety of mods chosen to create a balanced and enjoyable experience.

## Join the Adventure

This modpack is actively being developed for the community server, and you can follow its progress while trying out new features along the way. Expect regular updates, new content, balance improvements, and even more amazing mods to come.

Prepare for adventure, build your empire, conquer powerful bosses, and experience Minecraft in a whole new way.
